fairness.compute: Every arm gets the same datasource, seed, optimizer steps, learning rate, d_sae, and approximately 1024 reconstructed token positions per step (batch_size*T).
fairness.reporting: Parameter count, realized l0_per_window, realized l0_per_token, NMSE, and paired seed deltas versus both TXC baselines are all reported.
fairness.txc_post: Position-mixing/nonlinearity comparator: nominal shared-window support is k_pos; it reuses each active atom across T decoded positions and is reported separately rather than called equal-support.
fairness.txc_pre: Primary equal-code-support baseline: nominal shared-window support is at most k_pos*T, matching spectral's total per-band support.
